title: Composable Terraform blueprint for private EKS control plane with automated upgrade sentinels
creator: Jordan Kim
description:
Background:
Redwood Private customers require a robust, repeatable Terraform blueprint to provision EKS-based control planes inside customer VPCs. Current modules are fragmented: some teams maintain cluster bootstrapping, others handle lifecycle signals and upgrades separately. This ticket centralizes a composable module that can be imported by higher-level blueprints and consumed by both self-serve and managed flows.

Goal:
Deliver a reusable Terraform module that provisions the EKS control plane and associated minimal primitives (IAM roles, control-plane subnets, security groups, KMS integration hooks) with explicit hooks for: automated preflight checks, sentinel health probes that gate upgrades, and a safe rollback causal chain. The module must be idempotent, cloud-account friendly, and instrumented for runtime health signals that feed Redwood Console dashboards.

Scope (what this ticket includes):
- Terraform module API (variables + outputs) and examples for integration into customer VPCs.
- Integrated preflight validation step (network reachability, IAM permissions, quota checks) implemented as terraform-null-resource + local-exec tests + sigterm-safe idempotency markers.
- "Upgrade Sentinels": small Lambda probes and metric exporters that emit control-plane readiness metrics (API responsiveness, controller-manager restart rate, certificate expiration), plus an SNS hook to trigger canary pause.
- A consistent semantic-major-versioning strategy and upgrade notes template for the module.
- End-to-end test harness (terragrunt/ci) + acceptance tests that run against a sandbox AWS account.

Out of scope:
- Full managed worker node lifecycle (this ticket wires node group inputs but does not orchestrate worker updates).
- On-prem non-EKS variants (handled by a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: 1) terraform module 'redwood/priv-eks/controlplane' publishes variables and outputs documented in README and example usage; 2) Running examples against a sandbox AWS account completes provisioning and produces a control-plane endpoint and CloudWatch metrics; 3) Preflight fails fast with clear errors when VPC subnets are misconfigured or IAM lacks required permissions; 4) Upgrade sentinel Lambda emits readiness metric to a test metric stream and a canary deployment (simulated) can be paused when sentinel breaches threshold; 5) Module passes idempotency checks: repeated apply after successful run is a no-op except for driftable resources with documented behavior; 6) Security review completed and KMS integration validated; 7) Unit/acceptance tests exist in CI and a sample PR is merged with integration test results attached.
implementation_notes:
Design summary:
- Module layout: /modules/control-plane: main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, provisioners/, sentinels/, examples/; keep logic small and composable.
- Inputs: vpc_id, control_plane_subnet_ids, region, kms_key_arn(optional), control_plane_tags, lifecycle_policy (canary/cold), sentinel_thresholds (map), owner_team.
- Outputs: eks_cluster_id, control_plane_endpoint, control_plane_ca, sentinel_lambda_arn, cloudwatch_log_group_names, k8s_remote_exec_token_placeholder.
- Preflight: implement a terraform local-exec that runs 'redwood-preflight' shell script (written in Bash/Python) which checks: VPC CIDR overlap, route tables, required service endpoints, IAM policy simulation (sts:AssumeRole), and remaining ENI quotas. The script writes a sentinel file to S3 indicating success.
- Sentinels: lightweight Lambda (Go runtime preferred) that performs: 1) call EKS DescribeCluster + kube API healthcheck; 2) query controller-manager / kube-apiserver Pod restart counts via CloudWatch metrics or custom exporter; 3) publish a composite readiness metric to CloudWatch with dimensions {cluster,env}; 4) SNS publish on breach.
- Upgrade gating: we expose a boolean input 'allow_auto_upgrade' and a 'sentinel_grace_period' - terraform plan proposes upgrade but the orchestrating system (pipeline) must query the sentinel metric before applying in production.
- Observability: CloudWatch Metrics + Logs + optional export to Datadog; create pre-built dashboard JSON and a minimal metric math expression for console SLOs.

Implementation tasks (rough):
- Module skeleton + variables/outputs (Priya)
- Preflight script + CI validation (Jordan)
- Lambda sentinel code + deployment packaging (contractor/infra)
- Dashboards and metric publishers (observability)
- Integration tests + sandbox runs (QA)

Compatibility notes:
- Support terraform >= 1.4.0, aws provider >= 5.0; keep module to core providers only and avoid experimental features.
- Keep module ergonomics friendly for workstation use (terragrunt examples).
migration_plan: For teams using existing ad-hoc EKS provisioning we provide: 1) a migration guide that maps old resources to new module variables; 2) an idempotent import shim: terraform import script that can claim existing EKS cluster resources into the module state; 3) a phased cutover: create sentinel exports pointing at existing cluster to baseline metrics for 7 days, then switch control by applying module with 'manage_control_plane = true' in a controlled window. Communicate with customers via migration-runbook and offer managed assist for large fleets.
testing_plan:
- Unit: validate tf validate and tffmt checks; static checks for variable descriptions and type constraints.
- Integration: CI job that runs examples against isolated sandbox AWS account, tears down resources after success; test matrix includes: normal apply, repeated apply (idempotency), preflight failure conditions (missing subnets), sentinel breach simulation (inject high restart counts).
- Load/Soak: optional small ramp to ensure sentinel stability under control-plane churn.
- Post-merge: gated smoke run in staging account before cutting release tag.
rollbacks_and_canary_strategy:
- Canary flow: create a canary control-plane in a separate subnetset using module inputs; apply upgrades to canary first, monitor sentinel metrics for a configured observation window (default 15m). If sentinel metric crosses threshold, pipeline auto-pauses and notifies on-call with an automated diagnostic bundle.
- Rollback plan: module provides outputs needed for reconstructing previous config and an 'apply_rollback' helper which re-applies the last-known-good terraform state (backed by remote state snapshots). If control-plane regression happens, operator runs documented rollback steps which include: 1) restore control-plane version via eks update-cluster-version (if applicable); 2) revert any IAM or SG changes; 3) re-run preflight and sentinel baseline.
- Safety nets: module will never delete existing control-plane endpoint resources by default; destructive flags must be explicitly enabled and audited in the plan output.
observability_and_alerting:
- Metrics emitted: control_plane_api_latency_ms (p95/p50), control_plane_uptime_pct, controller_manager_restart_rate, kube_apiserver_error_rate, cert_expiration_days.
- Dashboards: sample CloudWatch dashboard JSON committed to examples/dashboards/ with pre-configured widgets for sentinel metrics and SLOs.
- Alerts: SNS topic + optional pager duty integration; default severity mapping: controller_manager_restart_rate > 5m -> P1, api_latency p95 > 800ms -> P2.
- Logging: Lambda sentinels log to CloudWatch and include structured JSON records for parsing in observability pipelines.
comments: 2026-02-19 Jordan Kim: Initial RFC drafted and pushed to Confluence. Calling out that the sentinel runtime should be Go for faster cold-starts in VPC-enabled Lambdas.
2026-02-23 Priya Desai: Reviewed variable schema and suggested swapping binary flags for an enum lifecycle_policy {managed, canary, manual}. Updated README example to show canary usage.
2026-03-01 Observability Team: Feedback: prefer metric namespace Redwood/EKS/ControlPlane and include dimensions {cluster_id, environment}. Also requested a sample dashboard JSON.
2026-03-05 QA: Sandbox runs passed basic apply/teardown; found a race where preflight S3 sentinel file was overwritten on parallel runs. Added lockfile logic to preflight runner.

2026-03-10 Security Review (Anna Rossi): KMS usage OK but require explicit kms_key_arn variable and default to not_create_key=true. Also requested IAM role boundaries on sentinel Lambda execution role.
2026-03-12 Priya Desai: Implemented sentinel SNS hook and added failure-mode docs. Preparing PR for module publish and tagging for release candidate.
2026-03-12 Jordan Kim: CI integration test matrix added. First sandbox canary run scheduled for 2026-03-15.
